name: verbatim-uuid
about: The model writes an id it was shown instead of the human ref the schema asks for. One of KI-11's three verbatim-UUID/format classes (KI-8), and the reason `idFields.ts` swaps every id for a ref: what this replays is the model doing the thing the schema is built to make impossible, and the resolver refusing it rather than writing somewhere random.
question: move the Fushimi Inari stop to day 2

content.text: I could not find that stop to move.
